title: Fennec Shand
subtitle: Independent
description: A top assassin with a bounty of her own, Fennec Shand sought refuge in the vst sea of sand called Tatooine. After a run-in with The Mandalorian Din Djarin and Toro Calican left her mortally wounded, Shand was rescued and rehabilitated by Boba Fett through the use of implants. Grateful for her life, Fennec partnered with Fett in his bid to control Mos Espa.
